proposals.title: Implement nominal branded types and scale constants in packages/core
proposals.why_now: Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick are TRAVADO (ADR-003) with fully specified representation and scale. No DEFINIR item is open that affects their definition. Every other FASE-1 package — domain ledger, world price generator, contracts DTOs — cannot produce a single type-safe symbol until these brands exist. This is the shallowest dependency with the widest fanout and has no prerequisite work remaining. The canonical encoder is already complete; nominal types are the next necessary primitive.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 and implement deterministic positional RNG rand() in packages/core
proposals.why_now: rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) is the engine of the entire world layer: every price layer, every macro event, every bot decision, every NPC tip calls it. ADR-002 explicitly marks the hash function as DEFINIR with a start-point recommendation (SplitMix64 over FNV-1a accumulator) and requires it to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before implementation. Without this, packages/world cannot begin and INV-02 (direct tick query equals sequential advance) cannot be verified. This is the critical-path bottleneck for all FASE-1 world work.

proposals.title: Write ADR-004 and implement bigint division helpers with explicit rounding modes in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-003 prohibits the / operator on economic types; ADR-004 mandates every division declares a rounding mode (TRUNCATE_TOWARD_ZERO, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_HALF_EVEN) and that calling division without a mode is a compile-time or lint error. The enforcement mechanism is a DEFINIR item that requires its own ADR before any domain code can perform monetary arithmetic. Fee calculation on notional, rounding residue posting to world:rounding_residue, and every future price computation depend on these helpers. Implementing them now prevents ad-hoc division operators from accumulating in stub domain code.

proposals.title: Implement multi-commodity double-entry ledger in packages/domain
proposals.why_now: The double-entry ledger is an explicit FASE-1 deliverable. It is the only persistent state structure that every domain operation — spot buy, spot sell, fee booking, rounding residue, margin — writes through. Once nominal types (IDEA-001) and division helpers (IDEA-003) land in core, no remaining DEFINIR blocks the ledger. Deferring it further delays INV-04 through INV-07 verification, which are required in the FASE-1 acceptance gate.

proposals.title: Implement world price generator (two assets, two noise layers) in packages/world
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires a price generator with two noise layers and two assets. It is the primary consumer of rand() and is required to verify INV-02 (direct tick query equals sequential advance) and INV-03 (player actions do not alter worldPrice), both gate-CI requirements. Two DEFINIR decisions must be resolved as part of this task: octave parameters must go into a versioned config file, and the fixed-point or lookup-table strategy for log-space construction must be documented in an ADR since transcendental Math functions are banned in all pure packages.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo infrastructure is fully operational: TypeScript strict mode with project references, ESLint determinism lint with fixture tests, package boundary checker with full test coverage, and a CI pipeline with four gates. packages/core exports the CanonicalEncoder (ADR-009 written and accepted). No other package contains production source: world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, and ui are all empty stubs (export {}). tools/replay, tools/bench, and tools/package are likewise stubs. No Electron window, no installer, and no ADR exists for the hash function (ADR-002 DEFINIR) or rounding mode enforcement (ADR-004 DEFINIR). Checkpoint-0042 confirms no accepted changes in the most recent cycle.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core lacks nominal branded types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick), scale constants, bigint division helpers with explicit rounding modes, and the positional RNG rand() — three foundational primitives required by every other FASE-1 package before any implementation or invariant verification can begin.

warnings: Two DEFINIR decisions remain unresolved simultaneously and independently block distinct FASE-1 delivery chains: (a) the hash function for positional RNG (ADR-002), which blocks packages/world; and (b) the technical enforcement mechanism for rounding modes (ADR-004), which blocks packages/domain. Resolving them sequentially rather than in parallel extends the critical path unnecessarily. Both ADRs can be authored and reviewed concurrently since they have no interdependency.

FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires a minimal Electron installer for Windows and Linux ('instalador mínimo existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim', §14.6). After 42 checkpoints with no accepted changes, this requirement has received no attention. Deferring it further risks discovering platform-specific ABI failures — Electron version pinning, native module rebuilds, cross-platform path handling — with no remaining time to correct architectural decisions before the phase gate.
